reviews.text:
We have been doing padel coaching with Alex and Sam for a few months now. Both coaches are patient, well organised and keep every session lively, so the hour flies by.

Our kids take tennis lessons with the same team and look forward to them every week.

A great choice if you want friendly, professional padel lessons.
reviews.author: Google reviewer A

reviews.text: Lovely coaches who teach my two daughters tennis. We would happily recommend them.
reviews.author: Google reviewer B

reviews.text:
Alex has made a real difference to my padel game. I used to feel awkward on court, and now every lesson is relaxed and fun while I can see clear progress.

She adjusts easily to each player: she also coaches my partner, who plays at a much higher level, and keeps him challenged too.

Her background in competitive tennis shows in how she explains technique and footwork. She also teaches our son tennis and swimming and is wonderful with children, calm and encouraging.

Whether it is padel, tennis or swimming, we are very glad we found her and recommend her to anyone.
